set.body:
Defect: D5 (no code reads any source manifest) + D7 (FixtureManifest.verify is never on a main path; probe.verifyInput at media/probe.scala:273 compares a CALLER-SUPPLIED Checksum). Guarantee 1: you cannot read a byte you have not hashed yourself. Revision 1's verify discarded the bytes it hashed, so open re-obtained them from an unstated source and nothing bound hashed to read; its ArtifactId => Option[Array[Byte]] also could not enumerate, making its own 'on disk but not in the manifest' test unimplementable.

Do: trait ArtifactStore { def list: Vector[ArtifactId]; def bytes(id): Either[IntakeRefusal, Array[Byte]] } -- ENUMERABLE, so completeness is checkable both directions. final class VerifiedArtifact private[corpus] (id, bytes: IArray[Byte], checksum): IArray, not Array -- TWO aliasing routes were demonstrated by probe (a public accessor, and the array the store still holds), so verify COPIES INTO OWNED STORAGE BEFORE HASHING and exposes no mutable backing array; structural equals compares contents. final class Verified private[corpus] (manifest, artifacts) carries what it verified. Thin v2 manifest = artifacts + RecordRefs + admission + contentPolicy + nonClaims + extensions, embedding NO Clock/Segmentation/CodeBook/Capability (embedding them is what stopped revision 1's minimum subset compiling). THIS IS 1.0 T8 done properly -- merge, do not run twice.

Tests: wrong schema; wrong version; length mismatch; hash mismatch; artifact on disk but absent from manifest AND vice versa. Mutation through the store's original array AND through a public accessor as SEPARATE tests (making Verified non-case addresses neither). Forge probe on Verified from storymodel4s.consumer.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): compare only byte length -> hash test fails. Skip the on-disk-not-in-manifest direction -> completeness test fails. Make Verified a case class -> consumer probe fails. Use Array and retain the store's reference -> both mutation tests fail.

Exit: Verified cannot be obtained without re-hashing every declared artifact from owned storage.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S1 'Guarantee 1'; S3 P2b-i
set.title: intake P2b-i: thin v2 manifest, ArtifactStore, verify, Verified (this IS 1.0 T8)
